description: A contour generator: one shape from a wavetable played once or over and over, used as an oscillator, an envelope, a modulation sequence or a drum voice

params.text: Sets the main time: a coarse tune in Audio range, the attack time in Envelope range, the cycle time in Sequence range, and the pitch of the drum when the module is in drum mode
Sets the second time: a fine tune in Audio range, the release time in Envelope range, the skew between rise and fall in Sequence range, and the decay when the module is in drum mode
Scans across the current wavetable, morphing the contour through the shapes stored in it
Sets one of the two voltages the main output runs between, -5V to +5V; patching the A input takes this knob out of circuit
Multiplies the B input by -1 to +1 to set the other voltage the main output runs between; with nothing patched to B the input reads 5V, so the knob alone gives -5V to +5V
Attenuates the Time 2 CV input before the module adds it, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Attenuates the Wave shape CV input before the module adds it, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Steps through what happens to the A and B levels at each contour event: Off, Track and hold A, Resample B, Track and hold A resample B, Track and hold A and B, or Resample A and B
Steps forward through the eight wavetables of the current range, wrapping round at the end
Steps through the frequency range the module works in: Audio, Envelope or Sequence
Steps through what a trigger does: No Retrigger, Hard Sync, A/R Model, Gated A/R Model or Pendulum. In drum mode it picks the drum instead: 808 Kick, Tom, Pluck or Tone
Steps backward through the eight wavetables of the current range, wrapping round at the start
Turns looping on or off, so the contour either repeats until stopped or runs once per trigger
Fires a trigger by hand, exactly as a rising edge at the Trigger input does

inputs.text: One of the two voltages the main output runs between; patched here, it overrides the A knob
The other voltage the main output runs between, multiplied by the B knob; unpatched it reads 5V
Modulates the main time, at 384 units of the internal 12-bit control range per volt
Modulates the second time, through the Time 2 CV scale knob
Scans the wavetable, through the Wave shape CV scale knob
A rising edge starts or restarts the contour; what exactly it does is set by the TRIG response button
Holds the contour where it is for as long as this is high

outputs.text: The contour, scaled between the A and B levels
A 5V gate, high during the release or during the attack according to the Logic out menu setting
The contour itself as a voltage, without the A and B scaling
A 5V gate that follows which way the contour is travelling

notes: the A input is normalled to the A knob: with nothing patched the knob sets that voltage, and patching a cable into A takes the knob out of circuit entirely.
the B input is normalled to 5V and the B knob multiplies whatever arrives by -1 to +1. Unpatched the knob is a -5V to +5V source; patched it attenuverts the cable.
the main output is the module's own signal scaled between the A and B levels. Set both of those to 0V and the main output is silent whatever else the module is doing.
each of the six buttons steps to the next mode when clicked. Hovering one names the mode and its number; right-click and you can type either to jump straight to it.
the two triangle buttons either side of the word TABLE step the same wavetable setting, one forward and one back.
menu: High during release — makes the gate output high while the contour is falling; found under the Logic out heading
High during attack — makes the gate output high while the contour is rising; found under the Logic out heading
Triangle — sends a plain triangle to the contour output instead of the shaped contour; found under Signal out, which appears when the frequency range is not Audio or looping is on
Contour — sends the shaped contour to the contour output; found under Signal out, which appears when the frequency range is not Audio or looping is on
Drum signal out: Triangle, Contour, Envelope, Noise — picks what the contour output carries while the module is in drum mode
Stock presets: Drum, Oscillator, AR Envelope, Looping AR, Modulation Sequence, Complex LFO — sets all six buttons at once to a factory combination
Select wavetable set — loads a wavetable file from disk in place of the one the module ships with

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the A knob.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 5V.
inputs.5:
high above 1.2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.6:
high above 1.2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
